## About

Nidhi Prajapati is a software engineer who builds AI agents and the infrastructure around them. She works as an AI Agent Reliability Engineer at Emergent (YC24), keeping autonomous coding agents and AI-generated applications reliable in production, and is part of the Nethermind Internship Program, exploring AI-supported blockchain systems: agentic systems, security, natural-language interfaces, protocol design and agentic payments.

She started a company at 17, Alphonse Esports, during COVID, then studied computer science at SMVIT (Sir M. Visvesvaraya Institute of Technology), Bengaluru. She found web3 in 2023 and built across multiple chains: SDKs, protocols, zero-knowledge proofs and agentic payments. She became an Algorand Foundation Ambassador, a SheFi Scholar and a Dev3Pack Fellow, ran workshops, mentored developers, and was the founding blockchain engineer at PeerHire. Since 2026 her focus is AI: agents, reliability, and the line where AI meets real systems.

She builds end to end, from product idea and design to production, and cares most about what something is for and how it feels to the person using it.

## Selected projects

- [Voxie](https://voxieai.vercel.app/): voice agents that speak your caller's language: listening, turn-taking, interruptions and the voice, in 17 languages. Open source: https://github.com/SomehowLiving/Voxie
- [REX by Softknock](https://softknockai.vercel.app/): an autonomous revenue execution agent that follows up every failed payment by email, text and a friendly call, in the customer's own language.
- [Inscribe](https://studio-bay-omega.vercel.app/): a browser extension and agent-native workshop built on WebMCP. It uses a website's own declared tools when it has them and infers capabilities when it doesn't, so an AI agent acts on meaning instead of pixels. https://github.com/SomehowLiving/Inscribe
- [ScreenMesh](https://screenmesh.vercel.app/): move work between your devices without moving it through an app you don't trust. Local-first, end-to-end encrypted. https://github.com/SomehowLiving/screenmesh
- [Onkey](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@onkey/sdk): self-hosted web3 authentication for everyone, with email login and smart contract wallets, published on npm as @onkey/sdk. https://github.com/SomehowLiving/onkey
- [Point](https://github.com/nidhiprajapati-ops/point): a system-wide spatial AI context layer: press a shortcut, select anything visible on screen, give an instruction, and get an answer or trigger an action.
- [Acre](https://acre-web-three.vercel.app/): zero-knowledge attestations that let gig workers prove their income without revealing their financial data.
- [Consensa](https://consensa.vercel.app/): three independent AI signals commit blind, and two must agree on-chain before anything trades.
- [Ward](https://ward-steel.vercel.app/): runs risky on-chain interactions inside disposable, loss-capped smart-wallet pockets.
- [x402 builder kit](https://x402-kit-kappa.vercel.app): a starter kit for AI agents that pay for APIs with the x402 protocol on Algorand.
- [ClinaraAI](https://clinaraai-eight.vercel.app): clinical decision support with explainable AI across six diseases.
- [UsageLedger](https://usage-ledger.vercel.app) and [Billing Migration Studio](https://billing-migration-studio.vercel.app): usage-based billing and billing-data migration infrastructure for SaaS.

All projects: https://www.somehowliving.tech/work
